name: Deflective Guard
exclusions: Adds redirection to the existing block rather than replacing it. No reflected damage, no disarm, no counterattack.
parent_disposition_reason: CONSERVE — the parent block stays independently useful; redirection is added, not substituted.

name: Sundering Blow
exclusions: Armour only. Shields, wards, natural hide and magical protection unaffected.
parent_disposition_reason: ABSORB — Committed Swing folds into the wrapper; its penalty reduction is subsumed by the new result.

name: Last Stand
exclusions: One round, once per encounter. No healing, no death prevention, no protection for allies.
parent_disposition_reason: CONSERVE — Refusal and Fighting Spirit remain useful on their own; Last Stand joins them at the death roll.
